title: Getting started with omicidxr
text: omicidx_connect() returns ordinary DuckDB DBI connection. version argument picks release: "latest" (nightly build, default), dated nightly build "YYYY-MM-DD" (kept 30 days), monthly release "YYYY-MM", kept long term one cite. vignette pins October 2026 monthly release results reproducible. omicidx_release() reports release connection , provenance release’s manifest.json: cite OmicIDX, cite DOI monthly release used, listed HuggingFace dataset page tag, state tag (2026-10).
code: library(omicidxr)  con <- omicidx_connect("2026-10") release <- omicidx_release(con) release[c("version", "publish_date", "transform_sha", "lake_snapshot_id")] #> $version #> [1] "2026-10" #>  #> $publish_date #> [1] "2026-10-20" #>  #> $transform_sha #> [1] "90688e92966330aac9ecd5a4fb8dc1d126f7982f" #>  #> $lake_snapshot_id #> [1] 4171

title: Getting started with omicidxr
text: SRAdb GEOmetadb deprecated. SQLite files downloaded whole longer updated. sradb geometadb schemas follow tables, code ports connecting omicidx_connect() prefixing table names schema. SRAdb GEOmetadb call followed omicidxr equivalent: getSRAdbFile(), getSQLiteFile(), dbConnect(SQLite(), ...): con <- omicidx_connect() dbGetQuery(sra_con, "SELECT * study ..."): DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * sradb.study ...") dbGetQuery(geo_con, "SELECT * gsm ..."): DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * geometadb.gsm ...") dbListTables(), dbListFields(): omicidx_tables(con), omicidx_describe(con, "sradb.run") sraConvert(in_acc, out_type, sra_con): sra_convert(con, in_acc, out_type) geoConvert(in_list, out_type, geo_con): geo_convert(con, in_acc, out_type) getSRA(search_terms, out_types, sra_con): sra_search(con, query) getSRAinfo(), listSRAfile(): sra_runs(con, in_acc), gives run accessions SRA Toolkit, file URLs (see Downloading FASTQs) characteristics_ch1 parsed hand: geo_characteristics(con, gsm) Differences watch : connection comes first every helper, work |>. Tables schema-qualified: sradb.study, study. Conversion also covers BioSample BioProject, SRA submissions GEO DataSets (GDS); marts submission, gds sMatrix tables. characteristics_ch1 characteristics_ch2 lists tag/value pairs rather ;\t-separated strings, array columns gse.pubmed_id lists. sra_search() case-insensitive pattern match, SQLite full-text search. Pin monthly release, vignette , SRAdb code pinned SQLite file.

title: Query SRA, GEO, BioSample and BioProject Metadata from OmicIDX
text: Access OmicIDX omics metadata database R omicidxr package provides convenient interface query explore OmicIDX metadata database, comprehensive resource omics dataset metadata. Built top DuckDB, enables fast, efficient queries large-scale genomics metadata without downloading entire database. users GEOmetadb SRAdb, omicidxr offers modern alternative cloud-native access, eliminating need manage large local SQLite files. Metadata coverage 40 million SRA experiments, 8 million GEO samples, 50 million Biosamples, accessible via SQL dplyr syntax without large downloads.

title: Query SRA, GEO, BioSample and BioProject Metadata from OmicIDX
text: 🚀 Fast queries powered DuckDB’s columnar engine remote Parquet ☁️ Nothing download – queries fetch columns rows need 📌 Version pinning – nightly "latest", dated build, citable monthly release 🔍 Full SQL support plus dplyr/dbplyr integration, tab-completion tables 🧬 SRAdb/GEOmetadb successor – sradb geometadb schemas follow packages’ tables 📊 Comprehensive schemas covering SRA, GEO, BioSample BioProject

title: Connect to an OmicIDX release — omicidx_connect
text: "latest": nightly build https://omicidx.cancerdatasci.org/data/latest/. "YYYY-MM-DD": dated nightly build, kept 30 days. "YYYY-MM": monthly release HuggingFace (seandavis/omicidx@YYYY-MM). Monthly releases kept long term version cite. Connecting takes longer (30 seconds) DuckDB inspects every Parquet file creates views. HuggingFace limits anonymous requests (3000 per 5 minutes per IP address) one query can make hundreds, heavy use can fail HTTP 429 window resets. Requests carry User-Agent omicidxr/<package version>. DuckDB extensions (httpfs, json) downloaded cached tools::R_user_dir("omicidxr", "cache"). connection neither uses ~/.duckdb reads DuckDB secrets persisted .

title: omicidxr 0.99.0
text: Bioconductor submission. omicidx_connect(version) opens DuckDB connection OmicIDX release: "latest", dated nightly build "YYYY-MM-DD" monthly release "YYYY-MM". Nothing downloaded front, DuckDB extensions cached tools::R_user_dir("omicidxr", "cache") rather ~/.duckdb. omicidx_release() reports connection’s release provenance manifest.json. omicidx_tables(), omicidx_describe() omicidx_db() list, describe wrap release’s tables tab-completable lazy dplyr tables.
